# FG-REPO-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`repo-storage`](../../ops/runbooks/repo-storage.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `init_bare_refuses_an_existing_path` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリを作成できませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The repository could not be created. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Repositori tidak dapat dibuat. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

Something already exists at the storage path of a repository being created. forge never initializes over existing data: an id reused after a database restore would otherwise expose another project's history.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `repo_id` and `path`. Compare the directory's content (`git -C <path> log -1`) with the database: a restored database whose id sequence went backwards is the usual cause.

## 対処 (fix)

Do not delete the directory blindly: identify which project it belongs to, move it aside, and advance the repository id sequence past the highest existing id.
